info.name: Arthur Properties API
info.description:
Arthur Properties API - the properties surface of the Arthur API v2, the UK property management platform from Arthur Online (an Aareon company). Derived operation-for-operation from the provider's public Postman Documenter collection at https://developer.arthuronline.co.uk/. Every request is scoped to an Arthur entity via the mandatory X-EntityID header and authorised with an OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code access token.

Contact Support:
 Name: Arthur Online API Support
